scope: All48 recorded episodes. No physics/controller/threshold changes. Rate data sampled every0.1s, not every0.02s; near-cap fractions are sample evidence, not exact tick saturation. q-to-nominal compares post-step q with pre-step nominal target and is descriptive; q-command offset alone includes static load compensation and is not tracking error.
conclusion: New joint17 housing contacts on cases0/1/6/7/10/11 were preceded by zero sensor-based load reduction, contradicting early unloading as their explanation. Simultaneous command lag and near-cap motion motivate a rate-feasible approach with tracking reserve, but do not establish sole causation.
